summary.text: Vernon Moore is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent James Dixon (R).
A U.S. Air Force veteran and former financial consultant, he also ran for this seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Moore was born in Warsaw, North Carolina, and served in the U.S. Air Force during the Vietnam War.

He earned associate degrees in industrial security and human resources from the Community College of the Air Force and a bachelor's degree in business administration from Fayetteville State University.
His career experience includes working as a financial consultant with Merrill Lynch.
Moore has run in several earlier general elections: he lost to incumbent Brent Jackson (R) in North Carolina State Senate District 10 in 2018 and 2020, and to Dixon in House District 4 in 2024.
